items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Taking a walk after a meal went with a rise about 3.2 mg/dL smaller in real adults. In the synthetic program, a walk after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Across the program, sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. A check in real adults pointed the same way, at about a quarter of the program's size.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 14.0 hours, and 88.9% of nights reached 13 hours. In the randomized program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
